title: Fix MCP library_rename command: returns isError true instead of mutating library
description:
E2E test 'MCP agent server: library domain: create symbol → library_rename → doc_get assert round-trip' fails: library_rename returns isError:true.

The MCP command handler for library_rename is either not implemented or not finding the library item by ID. Check the command registry for library_rename and ensure it calls the JSFL renameItem equivalent on the document model and returns success.

Key file: look for library_rename in the MCP command registry (packages/ or apps/desktop/src/)
Test file: apps/desktop/e2e/agent-mcp.spec.ts (library domain section)

Run: pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e --grep 'library_rename' 2>&1 | tail -20
